title: Mr.Ducky Studio is founded
body: Two friends, a shared Roblox group, and a run of small obbies and experiments like Animal Island.

title: The Squid Game launches
body: Our fan-made take on the Netflix show hits at exactly the right moment and becomes the studio's breakout title.

title: Wordly & Fall Block
body: A daily word puzzle and a block-breaking PVP experience — back-to-back releases in a single year.

title: Nation Survival, with Tiny Comet
body: Our first publishing partnership — a 1600s Jamestown survival game built under Tiny Comet.

title: Chained Up races past 10M visits
body: A co-op climbing challenge inspired by Chained Together — our fastest-growing release yet.

title: Liar's Game joins Altera
body: Altera acquires our social deduction game and we relaunch it as Truths Table, with AI agents that play and chat alongside you.

title: The Squid Game crosses 65M visits
body: Four years on, the game that put us on the map is still going strong.

title: Untitled Golf Game
body: Fast-paced multiplayer golf — race other players across chaotic courses, earn coins, and climb the leaderboards.
